title: UltraTools
description: This project adds Ultra Shards to the game witch can be crafted with 9 Obsidian and create Ultra Stuff like armor,tools and a bow
body:
This Mod adds Ultra Op Tools (Pickaxe,Sword,Axe,Shovel,Hoe,Bow,MultiTool) To the game With Ultra Shards, that act like Diamonds for a diamond pick so u will have to get 3 ultra shards and 2 sticks to craft an Ultra Pickaxe. It also adds Ultra Armor, which gives 5 Knockback resistance and 100 protection. The Ultra Bow can be shot without arrows and to get Ultra Shards you need 9 Obsidian. This mod also grants the Opportunity to craft netherite things without a smithing table, diamond gear and a netherite upgrade but just with Netherite Ingots. FOR QUILT USERS
Just Use the Fabric 1.21.8 Version and the Fabric API it works
